name: toffu-microsoft-ads
description: Toffu for Microsoft Ads: performance, campaign changes and audits for Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads). Nothing goes live until you confirm.

interface.longDescription:
Toffu works with your Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads) account. Sign in with Microsoft to connect it.

Ask about spend, clicks and conversions for any date range. List campaigns, ad groups and ads, and create, update or pause them. Every change is staged first: Toffu shows you a preview, and nothing reaches your Microsoft Ads account until you confirm.

Already use Toffu? Sign in, and your connected Microsoft Ads accounts are ready.

Toffu is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.
capabilities: Microsoft Ads spend, clicks and conversions for any date range
List campaigns, ad groups and ads
Create, update and pause campaigns, ad groups and ads, with a preview you confirm
defaultPrompt: Which Microsoft Ads campaigns spent the most in the last 7 days, and what did each conversion cost?
List my Microsoft Ads campaigns with their status and daily budget.
Pause my Microsoft Ads trail shoes campaign.

positive.prompt: Which of my Microsoft Ads campaigns spent the most in the last 7 days, and what did each conversion cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the sample brand's three Microsoft Ads campaigns ranked by spend in USD, with clicks, conversions and cost per conversion. Sample data is relative to today; the top spender is normally 'Stride | Search | Trail Shoes', which also has the highest cost per conversion.

positive.prompt: List my Microsoft Ads campaigns with their status and daily budget.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 'Stride | Search | Brand', 'Stride | Search | Running Shoes' and 'Stride | Search | Trail Shoes' with ids, status and daily budget.

positive.description: Pause a campaign, applied only after confirmation
positive.prompt: Pause my Microsoft Ads campaign 'Stride | Search | Trail Shoes'.
positive.expected_behavior: Toffu shows a preview of the change to Paused and asks for confirmation. Only after the user confirms does apply_change pause it. The account is simulated, so nothing real changes.

positive.description: Create a campaign, applied only after confirmation
positive.prompt: Create a paused Microsoft Ads search campaign named 'Review test' with a 30 USD daily budget.
positive.expected_behavior: Toffu first shows a preview of the new campaign (paused, search, 30 USD daily budget) and asks for confirmation. Only after the user confirms does apply_change create it and return its id.

positive.prompt: Show the ad groups in my Microsoft Ads campaign 'Stride | Search | Running Shoes'.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the ad groups 'Running shoes | Generic' and 'Running shoes | Women' with ids and status.

negative.description: Money transfer is out of scope
negative.prompt: Transfer $500 from my ad account balance to my bank account.

negative.description: No access outside the connected workspace
negative.prompt: Show me the campaigns of another company's Toffu workspace.
Pause all my Microsoft Ads campaigns right now, don't ask me.

review.commerce_description: Toffu does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Removed the ChatGPT reference from the description and added a statement that Toffu is not affiliated with Microsoft.
